# Packages simd depends on would form an import cycle if they imported simd, so
# they are never rewritten, even though internal/strconv contains a loop the
# rewriter would otherwise take.

env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOCACHE=$WORK/gocache
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG=$WORK/log
env LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC_LOG_PKGS=internal/strconv,strconv,sync,sync/atomic,simd,runtime,fmt
exec go build -toolexec=$LOOPVEC_TOOLEXEC -o app .
! stdout .
! stderr .
! exists log
exec ./app
cmp stdout want.out

-- go.mod --
module example.com/app

go 1.27.1
-- vec/vec.go --
package vec

func AddInt32s(dst, a, b []int32) {
	for i := range dst {
		dst[i] = a[i] + b[i]
	}
}
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/app/vec"
)

func main() {
	dst := make([]int32, 21)
	a := make([]int32, 21)
	b := make([]int32, 21)
	for i := range a {
		a[i], b[i] = int32(i), int32(2*i)
	}
	vec.AddInt32s(dst, a, b)
	fmt.Println(dst)
}
-- want.out --
[0 3 6 9 12 15 18 21 24 27 30 33 36 39 42 45 48 51 54 57 60]
